newsitem.title: CANADA: Newbridge to take stake in Coasin Chile.
newsitem.headline: Newbridge to take stake in Coasin Chile.

text.p: Newbridge Networks Corp said on Tuesday it is in talks to acquire a majority stake in Coasin Chile SA, a leading South American telecommunications engineering, distribution and marketing company.
Coasin Chile, a Newbridge distributor in Latin America for nearly 10 years, has operations in Chile, Argentina, Brazil, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Peru and Uruguay.
The letter of intent was signed at a ceremony which followed a keynote address by the President of the Republic of Chile, Eduardo Frei, to the Canadian Council for the Americas in Toronto.

With networking equipment from Newbridge, Coasin Chile installed the largest time division multiplexer network in South America in the Compania de Telecommunicaciones de Chile network and recently completed the installation of a nationwide commercial asynchronous transfer mode network for Entel Chile S.A..
Santiago-based Coasin Chile was founded in 1966 as a provider of scientific and industrial precision equipment.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
